data.spiritual_significance: For those who give their child the name Diahann, it is a declaration of faith and trust in God's providence. It is a prayer for God's grace and blessings in the life of the child. The name inspires a deep sense of gratitude and humility, reminding the parents and the child of their dependence on God's love and mercy. data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Diahann, of Hebrew origin, means "God is gracious" or "Jehovah is merciful." It is a name that symbolizes the boundless love and compassion of God towards His children. Every time a child with this name is called, it is a reminder of the endless grace and mercy of the Almighty.
